cards.ex: The office was in a state of disarray after the party.
cards.exUz: Kechadan keyin ofis tartibsizlik holatida edi.
cards.uzDef: Hamma narsa tartibsiz, chalkash va nosoz bo'lgan holat.

cards.ex: I try to keep things in order around the house, but it's hard with kids.
cards.exUz: Men uyda hamma narsani tartibli saqlashga harakat qilaman, lekin bolalar bilan qiyin.

cards.ex: The party got completely out of control last night.
cards.exUz: Kechagi bazm butunlay nazoratdan chiqib ketdi.

cards.ex: She tried to bring order to the chaotic filing system.
cards.exUz: U tartibsiz hujjatlar tizimiga tartib keltirishga harakat qildi.

cards.ex: Once we had the funding, everything started to fall into place.
cards.exUz: Bizda mablag' bo'lgach, hamma narsa joyiga tusha boshladi.

cards.ex: My bedroom is a complete mess right now.
cards.exUz: Mening yotoqxonam hozir butunlay chalkashlik.
cards.uzDef: Hamma narsa tartibsiz va iflos bo'lgan holat.

cards.ex: You need to get your act together if you want to pass the exam.
cards.exUz: Agar imtihondan o'tmoqchi bo'lsangiz, o'zingizni tartibga solishingiz kerak.

cards.ex: The rule of law is essential for a fair society.
cards.exUz: Adolatli jamiyat uchun qonun ustuvorligi muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Hamma qonun oldida teng degan tamoyil.

cards.ex: My sleep schedule is completely out of whack since I started working nights.
cards.exUz: Tungi ishni boshlaganimdan beri uyqu tartibim butunlay buzildi.

cards.ex: Who's going to clean up the mess after the kids are done playing?
cards.exUz: Bolalar o'ynab bo'lgandan keyin chalkashlikni kim tozalaydi?

cards.ex: The documents were all filed in good order.
cards.exUz: Hujjatlarning barchasi yaxshi tartibda saqlangan.

cards.ex: The airport experienced a system breakdown, causing major delays.
cards.exUz: Aeroportda tizim buzilishi yuz berdi, bu esa katta kechikishlarga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Tizimning ishlamay qolishi, muammo yuzaga kelishi.

cards.ex: Allowing exceptions to the rule can be a slippery slope.
cards.exUz: Qoidaga istisno qilishga ruxsat berish xavfli yo'l bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Kichik xato, jiddiy oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin.

cards.ex: My boss always does everything strictly by the book.
cards.exUz: Mening boshlig'im har doim hamma narsani qat'iy qoidalarga muvofiq qiladi.

cards.ex: I don't want to rock the boat by suggesting changes.
cards.exUz: Men o'zgarishlar taklif qilish orqali vaziyatni buzishni xohlamayman.

cards.ex: The police are responsible for maintaining law and order.
cards.exUz: Politsiya qonun va tartibni saqlash uchun mas'uldir.
cards.uzDef: Qonunlarga rioya qilish va tartibni saqlash.

cards.ex: Let's sit down and try to sort things out.
cards.exUz: Keling, o'tirib muammoni hal qilishga harakat qilaylik.

cards.ex: I made a complete hash of the presentation.
cards.exUz: Men taqdimotni butunlay chalkashtirib tashladim.

cards.ex: The company is a well-oiled machine.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yaxshi ishlagan mexanizm.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi tashkil etilgan va samarali ishlaydigan narsa.

cards.ex: We didn't have a plan, so we just had to fly by the seat of our pants.
cards.exUz: Bizda reja yo'q edi, shuning uchun biz shunchaki vaziyatga qarab harakat qilishimiz kerak edi.
cards.term: fly by the seat of your pants

cards.ex: The government needs to keep a tight rein on spending.
cards.exUz: Hukumat xarajatlarni qat'iy nazorat ostida ushlab turishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirni qat'iy nazorat ostida ushlab turish.

cards.ex: I'm in a muddle about what to do next.
cards.exUz: Men keyin nima qilishim kerakligi haqida chalkashlikdaman.

cards.ex: The children ran amok in the house while their parents were out.
cards.exUz: Ota-onalari yo'qligida bolalar uyda bosh-boshdoqlik qilishdi.

cards.ex: We need to create a level playing field for all businesses.
cards.exUz: Biz barcha korxonalar uchun teng sharoit yaratishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hamma uchun teng imkoniyatlar mavjud bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: We need to nip these rumors in the bud before they spread.
cards.exUz: Ushbu mish-mishlar tarqalishidan oldin biz ularni ildizida yo'qotishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: Let's get the ball rolling on this project.
cards.exUz: Keling, ushbu loyihani boshlaymiz.

cards.ex: We need to cut through the red tape to get this project approved.
cards.exUz: Ushbu loyihaning tasdiqlanishi uchun biz byurokratiyani yengishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: The company tried to keep a lid on the scandal.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya janjalni yashirishga harakat qildi.

cards.ex: The banking system is a well-regulated system.
cards.exUz: Bank tizimi tartibli tizimdir.

cards.ex: If you want to succeed, you have to play by the rules.
cards.exUz: Agar muvaffaqiyatga erishmoqchi bo'lsangiz, qoidalarga rioya qilishingiz kerak.
